body.condition: For every balanced \(m=m(n)\) with \(m\to\infty\), \(N\to\infty\), and \(m/n\to0\), there is a constant \(c>0\) such that \(P_{S_m}[\inf_{\beta\in\mathcal K}\operatorname{tr}\{\mathcal B_{T_{n,m}^{\mathrm{main}}}(\beta)^{\mathsf T}W\mathcal B_{T_{n,m}^{\mathrm{main}}}(\beta)\}\ge c]\to1\).

novel.justification: A positive unnormalized random-complement outcome--covariate signal prevents trace normalization from degenerating while leaving the normalized oracle geometry and second-order risk comparison to be derived.
